sections.title: Program Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete the following, with at least 50 units within the minimum of 60 upper division units, as specified below with a minimum graduation GPA of 3.00.

sections.note: For specific program information, course plans, schedules, etc., consult an Applied Sciences Advisor.

sections.title: Lower Division Requirements

requirements.title: One of MATH 150, MATH 151, MATH 154, MATH 157

sections.note:
Students must complete the courses listed below.
It is suggested that students complete a recommended schedule of courses within the first two years.

sections.title: Upper Division Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students are required to bring the total upper division units in CMPT/MACM courses to at least 50 units within the minimum of 60 upper division units, and an overall total of 132 units are required for the degree, together with a graduation grade point average of at least 3.00.

sections.note: Consult an Applied Sciences Advisor before commencing upper division requirements.

sections.title: Elective Courses
sections.note: In addition to the courses listed above, students should consult an Applied Sciences Advisor to plan the remaining required elective courses.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: One course in each of the six areas of Table I is required.

sections.title: Depth Requirement

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Eighteen units of additional CMPT courses numbered CMPT 300 or above must be completed, at least twelve of which must be numbered 400 or above.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: These eighteen units must include CMPT 405; at least one other course in the theoretical computing science concentration; and, unless given special permission, cannot include CMPT 415, 416 and 498.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: In addition, six units of research courses are required.

sections.note: In addition, six units of research courses are required including both of.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: For a BSc computing science degree, the following additional requirements must be met. two additional courses chosen from Table I, II or III.

sections.title: Areas of Concentration

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: As part of a major program, students may complete one or more concentrations from these six areas: artificial intelligence, computer graphics and multimedia, computing systems, information systems, programming languages and software, and theoretical computing science.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: To complete a concentration, students complete the major requirements, including four courses in the corresponding section below - Computing Science Concentrations, at least two of which must be at the 400 division.

sections.note:
The primary upper division requirements are structured according to breadth, depth and credential requirements as listed below.
Courses used to meet the requirements of a concentration may also be used to meet other program requirements.
